title: Multi View Browser
meta_description: It is a browser that can browse multiple sites simultaneously.
full_description: This app is a multi-browser through which you can browse several sites at the same time. You can monitor a site while automatically renewing several sites and browse sites while watching a video or looking at Twitter.Through the multi-browser, you can browse several sites at the same time, on a maximum of six screens.You can browse multiple sites at the same time, up to six screens, browse different sites and check everything at a glance.It is also useful for gathering information during disasters.
